startingPoints: Start with Cold Plunge as a Murph protocol_variant under experiment_family:cold-water-immersion.

Keep post-exercise cold-water immersion, winter swimming, cold shower, whole-body cryotherapy, contrast therapy, and mood-focused deliberate cold exposure separate until the evidence says they should merge.
Favor near-term self-experiment outcomes such as HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, perceived stress, mood, exercise recovery, and blood pressure over long-term disease or brown-fat claims.
Treat cold-shock response, arrhythmia risk, blood pressure spikes, and hypothermia as mandatory safety boundaries.

discoveryShards.topic: Direct cold-water immersion interventions, including cold plunge and immersion temperature or duration studies.
queryStrings: cold water immersion randomized trial adults temperature duration
cold plunge intervention study adults
cold water immersion dose response study humans
sourceTypes: Acute physiology studies with a stated immersion dose
directEvidence: Whole-body or neck-down deliberate cold-water immersion that could plausibly map to a Murph cold-plunge protocol.
adjacentEvidence: Cold showers, ice baths bundled with another therapy, or clinically supervised protocols that define only a boundary.
endpointFamilies: Blood pressure and resting heart rate

discoveryShards.topic: Reviews, meta-analyses, and guidance relevant to cold-water immersion and deliberate cold exposure.
queryStrings: cold water immersion systematic review humans
cold water immersion meta analysis safety adults
cold exposure consensus statement humans
directEvidence: Review-level evidence that directly addresses cold-water immersion or deliberate cold exposure in humans.
adjacentEvidence: Broad recovery or sports-medicine reviews that do not cleanly separate deliberate cold exposure from performance contexts.

discoveryShards.topic: Cold-water immersion after exercise for soreness, recovery, performance, and hypertrophy-interference questions.
queryStrings: post exercise cold water immersion recovery randomized trial
cold water immersion soreness performance hypertrophy review
cold water immersion after exercise safety study
sourceTypes: Resistance or endurance training interference studies
directEvidence: Only studies that directly inform how post-exercise cold immersion differs from a stand-alone cold-plunge experiment.
adjacentEvidence: Any evidence that should remain a separate post-exercise variant instead of merging into the default protocol.

discoveryShards.topic: Cold shock, arrhythmia, blood pressure, hypothermia, drowning risk, syncope, and contraindications.
queryStrings: cold shock response arrhythmia cold water immersion review
cold water immersion blood pressure contraindications
winter swimming case report arrhythmia hypothermia
directEvidence: Human safety findings tied to cold-water immersion, cold plunge, or closely matching whole-body cold exposure.
adjacentEvidence: Open-water, drowning, and rescue literature that defines a safety boundary without becoming a protocol efficacy claim.

discoveryShards.topic: Cold exposure effects on mood, stress, catecholamines, autonomic markers, and perceived resilience.
queryStrings: cold water immersion mood stress trial
cold exposure HRV adults study
cold plunge catecholamines stress response humans
directEvidence: Human cold-exposure studies that directly report mood, stress, HRV, or autonomic outcomes.
adjacentEvidence: Resilience narratives or observational lifestyle evidence that should stay context-only.

discoveryShards.topic: Cold exposure, arousal, sleep quality, sleep onset, and circadian-timing effects.
queryStrings: cold water immersion sleep study adults
cold exposure sleep onset circadian human
cold plunge sleep recovery wearable study
sourceTypes: Circadian or thermoregulation papers with human sleep outcomes
directEvidence: Human studies that directly report sleep or next-day recovery effects from cold exposure.
adjacentEvidence: Thermoregulation studies that support mechanism only and should not become a sleep claim.

discoveryShards.topic: Thermoregulation, autonomic response, inflammation, brown fat, and other mechanism literature for cold immersion.
queryStrings: cold water immersion thermoregulation mechanism humans
cold exposure inflammation physiology human study

adjacentEvidence: Mechanistic claims that cannot support a protocol outcome on their own.

discoveryShards.topic: Winter swimming, cold showers, whole-body cryotherapy, contrast therapy, and other nearby variants that should not be silently merged.
